title: Cyrus and the Crown
author: Gideon Ashgrove
blurb: Quentin Sterling, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
